mechanism: Preserve the vertical flip of individual glyphs but reverse the word order only once; match K and OO to opposite ends of D.
primary_mathematical_proof: Flip about the right edge reverses x and glyph order; the subsequent in-plane halfturn reverses x again and y once. Composition is(x,y)->(x,-y)+translation, so left-to-right slot order remains KANGAROO and every glyph vertically flips. All14 full contours including glass uniquely matchE (residual0; A-D differ). D has reversed glyph order although each K/N/G/O local contour is a vertical flip. The six partial outer edges leave black letters and white counters unchanged.
marker_roles: Red source K upper diagonal edge identifies the asymmetric LEADING word end.
Red D rightmost K corresponding vertically flipped diagonal puts that leading end at the opposite word end.
Blue source first O outer half-contour is one member of the trailing OO bundle.
Blue D second O outer half-contour binds it at the opposite end under reversed letter order.
Blue source last O outer half-contour supplies the second member of the terminal repeated pair.
Blue D first O outer half-contour finishes the reversed OO bundle, discriminating word-level order from local glyph handedness.
